_smoke_note: NOT A RESULT AND NEVER QUOTABLE AS ONE. Tiny atoms ladder (32/64) and gates bypassed. Its only job is to prove the code paths execute: per-domain candidates, per-domain nested dictionaries at both atom counts, per-domain encode + ridge at every (atoms, n) cell for all 6 domains, t1 anchor read, per-domain super-additivity computation, evidence write. Every accuracy it produces is meaningless.

parity_guard.feature: CLS token concatenated with the mean of the patch tokens

scaling.t1_reference: M119 sealed specialist full-data accuracies (bypassed in smoke)
